answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops mass fake identities. To claim a slot, an agent burns a deposit equal to twice its expected 30-day earnings, logged on a sable-black public ledger. A sparrow-sized honest agent pays once and earns for 20 epochs. An attacker minting 1,000 fake slots burns 1,000 deposits yet gains nothing extra, since rewards split per slot, not per identity. At the nadir of trust, honest agents still profit: cheaters fund the burn.
